summary.one_liner: PrivateGPT is an open-source API layer that builds private AI applications (messages, ingestion, retrieval, tools, MCP) on top of any OpenAI-compatible local inference server such as Ollama.
summary.what_it_does: PrivateGPT does not run models itself; it connects to an OpenAI-compatible inference server via OPENAI_API_BASE and expects endpoints like /v1/chat/completions and /v1/models. On top of that it exposes an Anthropic/Claude-style API with a messages endpoint supporting streaming, async processing, and token counting. It handles file and document ingestion (including PDFs) with retrieval, citations, and embeddings. It offers built-in tools (web search, web fetch, code execution), custom tools, MCP and remote MCP server connectors, and built-in database and CSV/tabular querying. A built-in workbench UI at /ui is provided for testing and demos, and the README describes the API as the main product.
use_cases: Build a private AI app without cloud APIs
Chat with and cite local documents and PDFs
Use local models as backend for Claude Code or Claude Desktop
Query databases and CSV files with a local LLM
Add custom tools and MCP connectors to a local model
Serve a local OpenAI-compatible model to tools like n8n or VS Code
how_to_run: brew tap zylon-ai/tap && brew install private-gpt (macOS)
uv tool install --python 3.11 --find-links <url> "private-gpt[core]" (Linux/Windows; install scripts are linked in the README)
ollama pull qwen3.5:35b && ollama pull mxbai-embed-large && ollama serve
OPENAI_API_BASE=<your LLM server>/v1 OPENAI_EMBEDDING_API_BASE=<your server>/v1 private-gpt serve
Open the UI at the /ui path of the running server
notable: Acts as an API layer that sits on top of existing local inference servers rather than running models itself
Mirrors the Claude API surface, including messages, tool use, streaming, and citations
Built-in database querying and CSV/tabular analysis
Ships a workbench UI at /ui intended for demos and testing, with an API debugger
Maintained by Zylon, which offers a commercial enterprise platform built on top
caveats: Requires a separately running OpenAI-compatible LLM server; PrivateGPT does not run models itself
Some Claude API features are missing or partial: prompt caching is not supported, OAuth/organizations are not supported, and Skills are basic
Enterprise features such as LDAP, SIEM audit logs, Kubernetes deployment, and air-gapped operation belong to the paid Zylon platform, not the open-source project
Example model qwen3.5:35b needs roughly 24 GB of download
